Okay, so I'm seeing a situation where a map is likely being loaded. I need to handle this gracefully to avoid any issues or unnecessary delays in the system. The best course of action here is clear: I need to introduce a "wait" call. This is the most efficient and straightforward approach. I'm essentially telling the system to pause execution briefly, allowing the map data to finish loading. This preventative measure is essential; I want the execution to not fail in attempting to access the data before it is ready.
